content.text: You're a digital creator in Nigeria, Ghana, or Kenya, struggling to collect payments for your ebooks, courses, or digital products due to platform restrictions. Stripe, PayPal, and other conventional payment gateways are unavailable or severely limited in these countries. This infrastructure problem can be solved by [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-building-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-complete-infrastructure-4|How to]]-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-about-venezuelan-creators-accepting-crypto-payments-guide|COREMERCH guide to everything]]-you-need-5|building]] a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, a platform that allows you to host your store without relying on these restricted payment gateways. In this guide, we'll walk you through the process of setting up a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, using the Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack from COREMERCH.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

When platforms like Stripe and PayPal fail, it's not because they're unwilling to serve your market, but rather because they're bound by regulatory restrictions and compliance requirements that limit their reach. In contrast, a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages uses the NOWPayments platform, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and has no KYC or buyer account requirements, making it an ideal solution for creators in restricted markets. By building on Cloudflare Pages, you can avoid the limitations of traditional payment gateways and focus on growing your business.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy your crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, you'll need to sign up for a COREMERCH account and purchase either the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack. The Sovereign Starter Stack includes the GitHub Pages + Apps Script + NOWPayments combination, while the Edge Commerce Stack includes the Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments combination. Both stacks provide a complete solution for hosting and processing payments on your crypto store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to configure your NOWPayments account to accept cryptocurrency payments and integrate it with your Cloudflare Pages store. You'll also need to set up a file delivery system using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and configure your SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings for email deliverability. COREMERCH provides a detailed guide on how to set up your payment and delivery pipeline using the Sovereign Blueprint.
By building a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, you can avoid the limitations of traditional payment gateways and focus on growing your business.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you can deploy your crypto store on Cloudflare Pages using the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack. The deployment process typically takes 4-6 hours, and COREMERCH provides 30-day support to ensure a smooth handoff. To process your first transaction, simply enable payment processing on your store and test it with a small payment to verify that everything is working as expected.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The post-deployment ownership transfer is explicit in every COREMERCH deployment. When the build is complete and the end-to-end test passes, COREMERCH provides the credentials and configuration details for every component under the customer's accounts. The GitHub or Cloudflare repository is under the customer's account from the start. The Supabase or Google Sheets database is under the customer's account. The NOWPayments account is under the customer's email. COREMERCH removes collaborator access upon delivery. From that point, the store runs entirely under the customer's own accounts.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The most important question is: Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages? The answer is yes, with the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack from COREMERCH, you can host your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages without relying on restricted payment gateways. This infrastructure solution provides a complete combination of free and paid tools that give you full control over your store and payment processing.
The Edge Commerce Stack from COREMERCH is a comprehensive solution that includes Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments, and is deployed in 48 hours.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for more information on how to deploy your Edge Commerce Stack, you can visit our product page at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. The Edge Commerce Stack is a comprehensive solution that includes Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments, and is deployed in 48 hours by COREMERCH. Alternatively, you can consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack for even more features and support.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, follow these steps: purchase the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack from COREMERCH, set up your NOWPayments account and integrate it with your Cloudflare Pages store, configure your file delivery system using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and deploy your store using the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack. Additionally, enable payment processing on your store and test it with a small payment to verify that everything is working as expected.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

The Sovereign Starter Stack (Stack 01) includes the GitHub Pages + Apps Script + NOWPayments combination, while the Edge Commerce Stack (Stack 02) includes the Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments combination. Both stacks provide a complete solution for hosting and processing payments on your crypto store, but the Edge Commerce Stack includes more features and support.
Can I use GitHub Pages instead of Cloudflare Pages for my crypto store?

Yes, you can use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to host your crypto store, depending on your needs and preferences. Both platforms provide a free hosting solution that can be used with the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack from COREMERCH.
What is NOWPayments, and how does it work?

NOWPayments is a cryptocurrency payment gateway that supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and has no KYC or buyer account requirements. It integrates seamlessly with Cloudflare Pages and other platforms to provide a secure and reliable payment processing solution.
How long does it take to deploy my crypto store on Cloudflare Pages?
The deployment process typically takes 4-6 hours, depending on your setup and configuration. COREMERCH provides 30-day support to ensure a smooth handoff and help you get up and running quickly.
Can I process payments in multiple cryptocurrencies on my crypto store?

Yes, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, and you can configure your store to accept payments in multiple currencies. This provides you with flexibility and choice when it comes to payment processing.
With NOWPayments, you can accept cryptocurrency payments securely and reliably, without the need for KYC or buyer account requirements.
